outcome: use of laparoscopy for cesarean scar pregnancy
cohort: 142 Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) patients at Beijing Friendship Hospital of Capital Medical University, from January 2015 to September 2019
finding: Transvaginal sonography (TVS) parameters, including maximal diameter of gestational sac, local myometrial thickness, fetal heartbeat, and color Doppler signals, were associated with the use of laparoscopy for CSP.
